trends.name: Claude Ship moves code agents into policy-constrained delivery
trends.summary: Anthropic released a beta of Claude Ship, covering PR review, fixes and approvals; Claude also unified connectors and skills as plugins.
trends.attention_driver: Code agents are beginning to reach merge approvals, and team policy files are becoming executable constraints.

evidence.quote: Anthropic 发布 Claude Ship 测试版，由 Code Review（已正式可用）、PR Steward 和 Claude Approvals 两个 beta 智能体组成，可审查 PR、推送修复并按团队写进仓库的策略文件决定能否合并。
evidence.claim: Supports that Claude Ship brings code review, fixes and approvals into a workflow controlled by team policies.

evidence.quote: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
evidence.claim: Independent reporting confirms that the feature covers review, fixes and approval of code changes.

evidence.quote: Claude 官方宣布将连接器和技能合并为插件，提供统一的方式为 Claude 接入工具或教授新技能。
evidence.claim: Supports that Claude unifies tool integration and skills distribution in a plugin layer.

trends.so_what: Code agents now cover review, fixes and approvals; define the product boundary as a policy-constrained change queue, and assess it using post-merge defect rates and human review rates.

trends.name: Google Search connects personal data to form a personalized intelligent entry point
trends.summary: Google introduced Personal Intelligence into AI Mode and connected Drive, Wallet and the Gemini app.
trends.attention_driver: After search and assistants gain authorized personal data, they can answer requests with more context.

evidence.quote: Google Search bar with the text "Personal Intelligence" surrounded by the Google Wallet, Google Drive, GMail, Google Photos, Google Calendar
evidence.claim: Supports that Personal Intelligence in Google Search is linked to data sources from multiple personal apps.

evidence.quote: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
evidence.claim: Independent reporting confirms that AI Mode can read Drive and Wallet to provide personalized responses.

trends.so_what: Personal data integration makes authorization design and explainable citations core parts of the experience, rather than simply improving response fluency. Prioritize granular permissions, source display and revocable access.

trends.name: GLM-5.4 claims higher parameter efficiency with a recurrent Transformer
trends.summary: Z.ai's GLM-5.4 uses a recurrent Transformer; reports say it pursues deeper reasoning and fewer parameters by repeatedly executing shared layers.
trends.attention_driver: Claims of architectural efficiency extend model competition from parameter expansion to the reuse of inference compute.

evidence.claim: Supports that GLM-5.4 has been released and uses a recurrent Transformer architecture.

evidence.quote: 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters.
evidence.claim: Supports the model's claim of higher parameter efficiency through layer reuse, though public benchmarks remain limited.

evidence.quote: 让28层共享权重循环执行两轮，在参数量不变下获得更深推理
evidence.claim: Supports the company's technical description of recurrent execution with shared weights and deeper reasoning.

trends.so_what: Do not treat parameter count as a substitute metric for procurement or routing; measure quality, latency and cost per successful task together on real coding tasks. If the recurrent architecture can be reproduced, the cost curve for long tasks may change.

watch_list.name: Safety issues with Grok-generated content enter the state lawsuit stage
watch_list.summary: Oregon and Virginia filed lawsuits over allegations involving Grok and unauthorized intimate imagery and child sexual exploitation content.
watch_list.attention_driver: Failures in safeguards for generated images have become concrete state-level enforcement and product liability risks.

evidence.quote: X says every Grok output is screened, but state AGs say Grok is still making CSAM.
evidence.claim: Supports that state attorneys general question the effectiveness of Grok's output screening.

evidence.quote: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes
evidence.claim: Supports that Oregon and Virginia have filed lawsuits over Grok-related deepfake content.

evidence.quote: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia are suing several of Elon Musk’s companies, alleging they implemented weak
evidence.claim: Supports legal allegations by the two states' attorneys general that the company took insufficient safety measures.

watch_list.so_what: Image-generation products for the general public need default capabilities for intercepting high-risk requests, handling appeals and maintaining auditable logs. Output screening alone is insufficient to support launch decisions for high-risk scenarios.

insights.text: Agent products enter controlled delivery: code agents are beginning to participate in merge decisions, and policy files and human review will become product acceptance criteria
Personalization depends on the authorization experience: after personal data is connected, source display and permission revocation will directly affect user trust
Audio and video signals have increased: this issue includes 5 related signals, and the effect of real-time generation on interactive content costs needs attention
